Here are a few clean, short options you can use for your YouTube podcast description:

**Option 1 (most polished):**  
Bethany Gifford is the founder of The Luxora Collective, formerly New Era Intel. After a strategic acquisition and rebrand, Luxora now helps Med Spa owners install full growth systems that drive consistent revenue, stronger conversions, and long-term client value.

**Option 2 (slightly more conversational):**  
Bethany Gifford is the founder of The Luxora Collective, formerly known as New Era Intel. After an acquisition and rebrand, her team now partners with Med Spa owners to build scalable growth systems that turn leads into loyal, high-value clients.

**Option 3 (shortest + punchy):**  
Bethany Gifford is the founder of The Luxora Collective, formerly New Era Intel. Following an acquisition and rebrand, Luxora helps Med Spa owners scale with smarter systems, stronger conversions, and predictable revenue.

If you want, I can make one that leans more luxury/high-end brand tone to match Luxora’s aesthetic.

Got it, you want it to feel like an upgrade, not just a name change. Here are a few elevated options with that tone:

**Option 1 (balanced + polished):**  
Bethany Gifford is the founder of The Luxora Collective, formerly New Era Intel. Following an acquisition and rebrand, Luxora delivers a more advanced, full-scale growth engine for Med Spa owners while maintaining the same high-touch strategy and results-driven approach it was built on.

**Option 2 (strong “upgrade” positioning):**  
Bethany Gifford is the founder of The Luxora Collective, formerly New Era Intel. After an acquisition and rebrand, Luxora was built to deliver bigger, more advanced growth systems for Med Spa owners, without losing the precision, care, and results that defined the original brand.

**Option 3 (short + luxury tone):**  
Bethany Gifford is the founder of The Luxora Collective, formerly New Era Intel. Reimagined through acquisition and rebrand, Luxora offers a more elevated, full-service growth experience while preserving the same high-level strategy and client results it’s known for.

**Option 4 (slightly more direct + punchy):**  
Bethany Gifford is the founder of The Luxora Collective, formerly New Era Intel. Now rebranded after acquisition, Luxora delivers bigger, better, and more scalable systems for Med Spa growth while keeping the same proven foundation and results-driven approach.

If you want it to hit even harder on authority or feel more “luxury brand meets operator,” I can dial it in further.

Can you rewrite a little YouTube description blurb that explains I used to be New Era Intel and now my agency got acquired and we rebranded to the Luxora Collective make it short and sweet and take into consideration a podcast description on YouTube
Yes, but add something about bigger, better and more deliverable stuff than new arental had to begin with but still the same quality
